label: RESOLUTION of the 0.22-0.31pb spread (task requirement)
status: All 8 non-run_05 runs report the SAME quantity at the SAME stage: MadEvent's post-unweighting 'Cross-section' summary line (parton-level, no matching applied anywhere -- ickkw=0/xqcut=-1 for every run, confirmed via banner inspection). NOT a matched-vs-unmatched or different-precision-stage confusion. Inverse-variance-weighted mean of the 8 (run_01,02,03,04,scan_D,repro_A,repro_B,repro_C) = 0.2300 +- 0.00054 pb, but chi2/dof = 24.7/7 (reduced chi2 ~3.5) -- individual deviations from this mean range from 0.7 to 3.0 sigma, meaning the quoted per-run statistical (survey/refine integration) errors mildly UNDERESTIMATE the true run-to-run scatter (by a factor of roughly 1.5-2x), consistent with known VEGAS-grid-reseeding behavior, not a gross inconsistency. run_05 (0.3057+-0.0035) is a QUALITATIVELY DIFFERENT case: 21.4 combined-sigma from this mean -- a genuine outlier, not just underestimated-error noise. Its only distinguishing feature versus run_03/run_04 (same 300-event target) is its iseed (57); most plausible explanation is that this specific random seed produced an under-converged VEGAS adaptive grid for one or more of the two contributing subprocess channels (P1_gq_zaq_z_vlvl / P1_qq_zag_z_vlvl) during its own independent survey. CONCLUSION: identical cards are broadly consistent (8/9 runs, with mildly underestimated per-run errors); run_05 specifically is a demonstrated non-convergence outlier and is excluded from any authoritative average, not evidence the setup itself is unreliable.
